paragraphs.text: The Haazda or Hazda ( /hɑːzdə/, HAHZ-də ) are a guildless volunteer law-enforcing corps in Ravnica .

The Haazda operate especially in the peripheral and "country" areas outside the major urban clusters, covering areas that are not covered by League of Wojek , the "official" lawmen. The Haazda are less trained and less well-armed than wojeks.

After the New Phyrexian Invasion , the Haazda founded an independent detective agency operating in same areas. Most of their work comes from private citizens rather than the guilds and tends to consist of civilian matters, such as tracking down missing objects or gathering evidence on deceitful business partners. Rougher and less disciplined than R.A.M.I. , they are more likely to resort to rough, aggressive methods to get the job done.
